notes:
New Features:

+ Moves Simple IPTV Prüfen next to the normal Prüfen button in the Senderstatus prüfen tab and replaces the previous IPTV heading/info area with the Auto Check toggle.

+ Removes the separate Auto Check tab and its redundant Site-selection controls.

Bugfixes:

- Prevents overlapping Senderstatus/Auto Check runs from opening nested Settings windows while a check is already active.

- Adds stronger FuckFlix gateway cleanup during Senderstatus/Auto Check and suppresses repeated Kodi retries after a confirmed gateway playback failure so one bad stream cannot block the full check.
